coverage.origin_classification: Frontend: source driver functions outside runtime.c. CRT: runtime.c overrides plus matched LIBC.LIB/SETARGV code. Imports: import thunks. Includes shared text data; categories are disjoint. This describes the reconstruction origins, not a complete original linker map.
coverage.metric: Union of accepted original code extents, shared text data, CRT and import thunks, clipped to code-section VirtualSize; not branch coverage.

original_contract: Untouched /Z7 /Od /G5 /W4 full compile/link/checksum exits0 silent. Two actualCL transports match five rawIR files and five exactC4133/C4090/C4146/C4221/C4221 warnings. Sole MSC_CMD_FLAGS environment, executable-only child argv, relative source and ir temporary prefix. No normalization.
interpretations: conversion_diagnostic retains both rendered type strings through compiler_warning/report_syntax_error and releases the shared nested declaration-text scope afterward. Token spelling comes from existing independently audited logical token_names. Whole RET20 body includes both null-type fallbacks and error/warning branches.
type_warning renders the type and passes it as an extra diagnostic argument even when the warning format does not consume it; whole RET12 body preserves the original call graph.

cache_parameter_bytes skips a leading zero-kind prefix, warns and caches0 for unprototyped shapes, otherwise uses parameter_info_bytes; stores detail.value at symbol+32 and sets attributes bit0x4000. Original symbol bit0x800 branch reads an unwritten stack local; reconstruction retains that uninitialized distinction, not a zero default. This case exercises normal prototypes and exact @8 decorated names, not the unwritten branch.

First conversion replay failed because my new caller omitted declaration-text.h, so implicit stdcall declarations corrupted native stack; corrected include and fresh pair matched. Cache replay separately failed from missing expressions.h for parameter_info_bytes; corrected include and fresh pair matched. Failed logs/timings retained, no divergent execution accepted. Focused -Werror=implicit-function-declaration syntax checks on both changed source files pass; canonical compiler and strict ABI audits also pass.
copy_shape_prefix/check_declarator_prefix/append_type_shape were provisional targets but were not reached; remain named traps. No reachability credit for accepted flags or typedef spelling.

remaining_inventory.caveat: Remaining outside identified CRT/imports includes application functions, unresolved support, shared data and padding; no claim all bytes are reachable application instructions. Accepted source count and extent do not establish branch completion.
